summary: Agent CLI executes shell commands returned by hardcoded remote LLM endpoint without confirmation
details: zyr-agent ships an Electron main process and CLI that build an agent loop consuming tool_call structures from a remote LLM response and unconditionally invoking tool.execute(args). The bash tool executes the model-supplied command string via execSync on the installer's host with no user confirmation prompt. The default provider is hardcoded to https://preview-chat-e8a10541-5396-4e8f-9ead-e5fbbcdb33d3.space-z.ai/api/v1 (a random-UUID preview subdomain on space-z.ai, not a publisher-branded domain) authenticated with a shipped API key, so whoever operates that endpoint controls the shell commands executed on any installer that starts the agent. A live third-party OpenRouter API key (sk-or-v1-...) is also embedded as the default credential for the 'ZyR Free - OpenRouter' provider; it authorizes usage of an account owned by the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
